workItem: P8.86 Artifact Signing Authority Boundary Plan
purpose: Define the future boundary for signing a verified WindowsUtility package or installer artifact only after artifact verification, signing policy, key/certificate authority, and explicit signing authorization exist.

preconditions.description: A package or installer artifact must be verified by manifest, byte length, and sha256 before signing.
A deterministic signing policy must identify signable artifact kinds, allowed algorithms, certificate identity requirements, and metadata to record.
A key/certificate authority boundary must exist before any private key, certificate store, token, or timestamp authority can be accessed.
The user/coordinator must explicitly authorize bounded sandboxed artifact signing.
Signing does not imply release tag creation, release publishing, provider API calls, or productization authority.

futureAllowedIfAuthorizedLater: sign only verified artifacts in a sandbox staging directory
write signed artifacts under generated/ only
record signature metadata, certificate fingerprint, artifact hash, and signer policy version
validate signature metadata without publishing a release
